headline: MIA @ TBR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIA 3.66 at TBR 4.28, with a projected total of 7.94. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (MIA +0.46, TBR +0.35), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.81, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Drew Rasmussen has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Otto Lopez, Chandler Simpson, Junior Caminero, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Esteury Ruiz, Joe Mack because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
